title: Top-level harm
description: A root of the tree. Executive-owned; bounded by one or two tolerances; rarely changes. Five to seven total.

statement.description: What the company suffers, in plain executive language. The thing tolerance is written against.

owner.description: Executive seat that owns this harm. A person or role, outside the security function where the decision is a business one.

tolerances.description: The one or two tolerance sentences that bound this harm.

intermediate_harms.description: Which intermediate-harm vocabulary terms roll up into this root. Optional; the engine can also infer from risks.
